text: ∀x (Organism(x) ∧ CanProduceOwnFoodThroughPhotosynthesis(x) ∧ ProvideEnergyForOthers(x) ∧ ¬ConsumesOtherOrganisms(x) → PrimaryProducer(x)) ::: Organisms that can produce their own food through photosynthesis, provide energy for other organisms, and do not consume other organisms are primary producers.
